title: Connect libre2 with xdrip directly
symptom: The user wants to connect Libre2 with xDrip directly without using the patched app, and use xDrip at night while the son uses the Libre reader during the day.
cause: It is not possible to get data into xDrip+ without the patched app, and it is not possible to use the reader and the phone simultaneously because the sensor remembers the device it was started from and only that device can receive alarms.
fix: The user decided to buy the Bubble (a transmitter) to use with xDrip, as an alternative to the patched app and reader combination.
evidence_quote: No, it isn't possible to get data into xDrip+ without the patched app. It might be possible in the future but it will never be possible to use it side-by-side with the Libre reader because either the app or the reader can use Bluetooth to communicate with the sensor.
